entities.name: Measurement Object Addition/Modification Procedure
entities.description: UE procedure for processing measurement object configuration received in measObjectToAddModList. It handles addition, modification, and removal of measurement objects and their associated parameters.

entities.name: measObjectToAddModList
entities.description: List containing measurement objects to be added or modified, each identified by measObjectId.

entities.name: measObject
entities.description: Measurement object configuration containing various lists for cell management, exclusion, and transmission resource pools.

entities.name: VarMeasConfig
entities.description: UE variable storing the current measurement configuration including measObjectList and measIdList.

entities.name: cellsToRemoveList
entities.description: List of physical cell IDs to be removed from the cellsToAddModList.

entities.name: cellsToAddModList
entities.description: List of cells to be added or modified in the measurement configuration.

entities.name: excludedCellsToAddModList
entities.description: List of PCI ranges for cells to be excluded from measurements.

entities.name: allowedCellsToAddModList
entities.description: List of PCI ranges for cells allowed for measurements.

entities.name: tx-PoolMeasToAddModList
entities.description: List of transmission resource pools for measurement configuration.

entities.name: ssb-PositionQCL-CellsToAddModList
entities.description: List of SSB position quasi-colocation cells for measurement configuration.

entities.name: T321
entities.description: Periodical reporting timer for measurement reporting.

entities.name: VarMeasReportList
entities.description: UE variable storing the current measurement reporting entries.

relations.description: Procedure processes each measObjectId in the received measObjectToAddModList.
Procedure accesses and modifies the VarMeasConfig variable.
measObject may include cellsToRemoveList for cell removal operations.
measObject may include cellsToAddModList for cell addition/modification.
measObject may include excludedCellsToAddModList for cell exclusion management.
measObject may include allowedCellsToAddModList for cell allowance management.
measObject may include tx-PoolMeasToAddModList for transmission resource pool management.
measObject may include ssb-PositionQCL-CellsToAddModList for SSB position QCL cell management.
Procedure stops timer T321 when measurement reporting entries are removed.
Procedure stops timer T322 when measurement reporting entries are removed.
Procedure removes measurement reporting entries from VarMeasReportList.
